mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_name, d.dept_code, COUNT(a.id) as announcement_count FROM sys_department d LEFT JOIN sys_announcement a ON d.id = a.dept_id AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY d.id, d.dept_name, d.dept_code ORDER BY announcement_count DESC

SELECT d.dept_name, d.dept_code, COUNT(a.id) as announcement_count FROM sys_department d LEFT JOIN sys_announcement a ON d.id = a.dept_id AND a.status = 1 WHERE d.id = #{deptId} GROUP BY d.id, d.dept_name, d.dept_code

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_announcements, SUM(CASE WHEN is_top = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as top_announcements, SUM(view_count) as total_views, AVG(view_count) as avg_views FROM sys_announcement WHERE status = 1
AND dept_id = #{deptId}

SELECT d.dept_name, d.dept_code, COUNT(a.id) as announcement_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.announcement_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as notice_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.announcement_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as activity_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.announcement_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as other_count FROM sys_department d LEFT JOIN sys_announcement a ON d.id = a.dept_id AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY d.id, d.dept_name, d.dept_code ORDER BY announcement_count DESC
